standard.summary: 冻结随机初始化的 A（lora_down），只训练零初始化的 B（lora_up）；注入的模块集合与普通 LoRA 完全一样，不改靶子。同族上游 LoRA-FA (arXiv:2308.03303) 还给 B 的更新做闭式梯度校正，本仓没有 ⇒ 不等价。
standard.effect: 适配器可训练参数从 r×(in+out) 降到 r×out（约一半），优化器状态随之减半；B 零初始化 ⇒ 起步 delta 恰为 0，与不开启位级一致。
standard.whenToUse: 想在同一 rank 下压低优化器状态与显存，且接受「A 不参与学习」这个约束时。
standard.avoidWhen: 需要 A/B 都学的表达力时；需要论文 LoRA-FA 闭式梯度校正语义时。它不改变注入的模块集合，所以不要用它来「只训 attention 跳过 FFN」。

standard_en.summary: Freezes the randomly initialised A (lora_down) and trains only the zero-initialised B (lora_up); the set of injected modules is exactly the same as ordinary LoRA, so the targets do not change. The upstream sibling LoRA-FA (arXiv:2308.03303) also applies a closed-form gradient correction to B's update, which this repository does not, so the two are not equivalent.
standard_en.effect: The adapter's trainable parameters drop from r x (in+out) to r x out (about half), and the optimizer state halves with them; because B starts at zero the initial delta is exactly 0, bit-identical to leaving it off.
standard_en.whenToUse: When you want lower optimizer state and VRAM at the same rank and accept that A does not learn.
standard_en.avoidWhen: When you need the expressiveness of both A and B learning, or the paper's closed-form gradient correction semantics. It does not change the set of injected modules, so do not reach for it to train attention only and skip the FFN.

advanced.principle: 标准 LoRA 注入所有 Linear 层（attention + FFN）。LoRA-FA 只对 attention 的 Q/K/V/O 投影注入，FFN 的 up/down/gate 投影保持冻结。attention 层通常占模型参数的 30-40%，所以参数减少比例显著。
advanced.intervention: 修改 LoRA 注入的目标模块列表，排除 FFN 相关 Linear。
advanced.expectedImpact: 质量损失通常 < 2%（attention 层承载了大部分跨模态信息），但训练速度和显存改善明显。
advanced.tradeoffs: 可与 network_train_unet_only 组合进一步减少训练范围。

advanced_en.principle: Standard LoRA injects all Linear layers (attention + FFN). LoRA-FA injects only attention's Q/K/V/O projections, keeping the FFN's up/down/gate projections frozen. Attention layers usually hold 30-40% of model parameters, so the parameter reduction is significant.
advanced_en.intervention: Modifies the LoRA injection target-module list, excluding FFN-related Linears.
advanced_en.expectedImpact: Quality loss usually < 2% (attention layers carry most cross-modal information), with clear training-speed and VRAM gains.
advanced_en.tradeoffs: Can combine with network_train_unet_only to shrink the training scope further.
